Default: `"none"` - `legend_title_face`: Character. Font face legend title. Default: `"bold"` - `legend_text_face`: Character. Font face legend text. Default: `"plain"` - `legend_text_size`: Numeric. Default: `NULL` - `panel_cols`: Numeric `NULL`. Number columns panel layout. Default: `NULL` - `theme`: ggplot2 theme object `NULL`. Custom ggplot theme.
